description: Deep-audit code, CI/CD pipelines, Dockerfiles, shell scripts, Makefiles, Python projects, and config files for half-baked workflows — patterns that add complexity without value. Trigger this skill whenever the user asks to "review my pipeline", "audit this config", "why is this so complicated", "is this over-engineered", "does this make sense", "clean up my workflow", "simplify this", "what's wrong with this", or pastes a CI/CD YAML, Dockerfile, Makefile, shell script, or multi-step config and asks for feedback. Also trigger on vague requests like "take a look at this" or "is this okay" when the input is a workflow artifact. Produces a compound-smell report with severity, confidence, effort estimate, diff-style fix, smell interaction map, and a phased refactor roadmap.
